svg.title: Placax full architecture with four independent swappable axes
svg.desc: Yosys, fixed and external, produces the netlist. Placax's EnvState and EnvParams feed the single placax kernel, reset and step, differentiable and supporting jit and vmap. Four independent axes are supplied from outside the kernel: algorithm_fn and state_fn from placax_agents, now factored apart rather than welded together, reward_fn and optional init_fn from the user's project script, and a newly reopened regime_fn allowing either online from-scratch training or offline pretraining followed by fine-tuning. The kernel outputs placed macro positions, handed to an external, swappable cell placer defaulting to DREAMPlace and a validator defaulting to OpenROAD, which occasionally check true power, performance, and area.
svg.text: amber = inside placax · teal = external tools (dashed = swappable) · purple = placax_agents
